images.title: The mean balances the data
images.purpose: Show the five daily flower counts as dots on a beam that balances exactly at the mean, 5.
images.composition: One number line acting as a beam across the middle of the frame, resting on a single triangle under 5, with white space above and below.
exact_structure: A horizontal grey (#6B7280) number line from 0 to 10 with a tick at every whole number; ticks numbered 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 only.
Exactly 5 teal (#0072B2) dots, one each above 2, 3, 4, 7 and 9.
A reddish purple (#CC79A7) triangle fulcrum directly under the 5 tick, with the label Balances at 5 just below it.
The beam is perfectly level, not tilted.
The caption Flowers per day under the right part of the line.
Arithmetic check for the reviewer only, NOT drawn in the frame: 2 + 7 + 9 + 4 + 3 = 25 and 25 ÷ 5 = 5; distances from 5 on the left are 3, 2, 1 (total 6) and on the right 2, 4 (total 6).
rejection: more or fewer than 5 dots, or a dot at 5
the fulcrum under any value other than 5
dots placed at values other than 2, 3, 4, 7 and 9
images.takeaway: The mean is the balance point of the data, and it need not be one of the data values.
images.description: A level number line from 0 to 10 with teal dots at 2, 3, 4, 7 and 9 rests on a purple triangle under 5, labelled Balances at 5.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Ask students to compare the total distance of the dots left of 5 with the total distance right of 5.

image_decisions.why: A balance picture shows the mean as the levelling value that need not be a data value.
